scope: Static installed files and saved log only; no vendor execution, live process/device access, privileges, network or runtime changes
binary_address_kind: ELF32 virtual addresses, not runtime addresses; .text file offset = VA - 0x1000, cited constants VA = file offset

anchors.fact: Dispatches SDL event 0x659 to sensor path
Requires event.which at +0x10 to equal device SDL instance at +0x08 before sensor handler call
Sensor handler: standard gyro 2 and acceleration 1 use main lane; 4/3 use left lane; 6/5 have base-sensor fallback checks
Standard gyro sensor_timestamp at ELF32 event +0x24/+0x28 divided by 100; low 32 bits retained
Gyro affine conversion followed by saturation and int16 storage
Writes main gyro int16 values at record +0x1c/+0x1e/+0x20 and ORs flags 0x402
Existing nonzero main-lane sensor tick causes old record to flush on next gyro event; no acceleration condition in this branch
Flush enqueues record; optional earlier branch alters button field +0x10, not sensor flags +0x0c
Backend reader takes pending record from device queue, representation-dependent copy, maximum 0x48 bytes
Packet converter recognizes main gyro with (flags & 0x402)==0x402
Copies main gyro independently; absent acceleration bit 0x4 still branches to timing processing at 0x12439b0
Sensor timing helper includes packet-rate estimation and configurable fallback; actual selected settings not measured
UI notification producer has controller presence, pointer and subscription gates
Before motion notifications checks returned object byte +0x5c and any nonzero 16-bit value in selected controller state +0x1a4/+0x1a6/+0x1a8. Meaning and live values of triplet not established
Gyro speed notification construction gated by subscriber count

ui_character_anchors.fact: Rate display reads GyroRawSpeed, not GyroFilteredSpeed; orientation reads GyroRawQuaternion
Feed store defaults gyro rates to zero; state separated by controller_index and imu_index
Gyro speed notification callback copies raw/filtered values; imu_index 1 selects main lane, others left
Mount/unmount starts/ends ControllerStateFlow; gyro speed flow_mode is 3, quaternion 2; selected side chooses main/left store

conversion_model.label: Independent mathematical replay of affine clamp only; not Steam execution, full filter emulation or bit-exact x87 proof

missing_live_evidence: SDL event queue/watch callback delivery and device-object instance match
Internal packet consumer, motion-object readiness and exact triplet meaning
Controller index, IMU index and notification subscriptions selected by actual UI
Actual timing policy and downstream motion/antidrift state
conclusion: Cause narrowed downstream of changing enabled SDL cache; exact failing gate not proved. No evidence justifying driver/Steam changes or fabricated acceleration.
